questions.q: "Rapid Financing Instrument" and "Rapid Credit Facility" are related to the provisions of lending by which one of the following?
o: United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative
questions.e: The Rapid Financing Instrument and Rapid Credit Facility are IMF windows for quick emergency balance-of-payments support; the RCF is concessional for low-income countries.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q1

questions.q:
With reference to the Indian economy, consider the following statements:
1. An increase in Nominal Effective Exchange Rate (NEER) indicates the appreciation of rupee.
2. An increase in the Real Effective Exchange Rate (REER) indicates an improvement in trade competitiveness.
3. An increasing trend in domestic inflation relative to inflation in other countries is likely to cause an increasing divergence between NEER and REER.
Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.e: A rising NEER means the rupee has appreciated, and higher domestic inflation widens the gap between REER and NEER. A rising REER means exports are dearer, i.e. weaker competitiveness, so 2 is wrong.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q2

questions.q:
With reference to the Indian economy, consider the following statements:
1. If the inflation is too high, Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is likely to buy government securities.
2. If the rupee is rapidly depreciating, RBI is likely to sell dollars in the market.
3. If interest rates in the USA or European Union were to fall, that is likely to induce RBI to buy dollars.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: To support a falling rupee the RBI sells dollars, and when lower foreign rates bring in inflows it buys dollars. Buying government securities adds money and would worsen inflation, so 1 is wrong.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q3

questions.q:
With reference to the "G20 Common Framework", consider the following statements:
1. It is an initiative endorsed by the G20 together with the Paris Club.
2. It is an initiative to support Low Income Countries with unsustainable debt.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The G20 Common Framework (2020), agreed with the Paris Club, restructures the debt of low-income countries case by case. Both statements are correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q4

questions.q:
With reference to the Indian economy, what are the advantages of "Inflation-Indexed Bonds (IIBs)"?
1. Government can reduce the coupon rates on its borrowing by way of IIBs.
2. IIBs provide protection to the investors from uncertainty regarding inflation.
3. The interest received as well as capital gains on IIBs are not taxable.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: IIBs protect investors from inflation, so the government can borrow at a lower real coupon. They get no special tax exemption, so 3 is wrong.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q5

questions.q:
With reference to foreign-owned e-commerce firms operating in India, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. They can sell their own goods in addition to offering their platforms as market-places.
2. The degree to which they can own big sellers on their platforms is limited.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Foreign-owned e-commerce firms may run only a marketplace, not sell their own inventory, and sellers in which they hold equity cannot sell on their platform at all. Neither statement is correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q6

questions.q:
Which of the following activities constitute real sector in the economy?
1. Farmers harvesting their crops
2. Textile mills converting raw cotton into fabrics
3. A commercial bank lending money to a trading company
4. A corporate body issuing Rupee Denominated Bonds overseas
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The real sector produces goods and services, like farming and textile mills. Bank lending and bond issues belong to the financial sector.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q7

questions.q: Which one of the following situations best reflects "Indirect Transfers" often talked about in media recently with reference to India?
o: An Indian company investing in a foreign enterprise and paying taxes to the foreign country on the profits arising out of its investment
A foreign company investing in India and paying taxes to the country of its base on the profits arising out of its investment
An Indian company purchases tangible assets in a foreign country and sells such assets after their value increases and transfers the proceeds to India
A foreign company transfers shares and such shares derive their substantial value from assets located in India
questions.e: An indirect transfer is a sale of shares of a foreign company whose value comes mainly from assets in India; the Finance Act 2012 made such gains taxable in India.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q8

questions.q:
With reference to the expenditure made by an organisation or a company, which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. Acquiring new technology is capital expenditure.
2. Debt financing is considered capital expenditure, while equity financing is considered revenue expenditure.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Buying new technology is capital expenditure because it creates a lasting asset. Debt and equity are ways of raising funds, not types of expenditure.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q9

questions.q:
With reference to the Indian economy, consider the following statements:
1. A share of the household financial savings goes towards government borrowings.
2. Dated securities issued at market-related rates in auctions form a large component of internal debt.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.e: Household savings fund government borrowing through small savings and through banks and insurers. Dated securities sold at auction form most of internal debt. Both are correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q10

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Pursuant to the report of H.N. Sanyal Committee, the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 was passed.
2. The Constitution of India empowers the Supreme Court and the High Courts to punish for contempt of themselves.
3. The Constitution of India defines Civil Contempt and Criminal Contempt.
4. In India, the Parliament is vested with the powers to make laws on Contempt of Court.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The Contempt of Courts Act 1971 followed the Sanyal Committee report; Articles 129 and 215 empower the courts to punish contempt; and Parliament can legislate on it. The Constitution does not define civil and criminal contempt.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q11
questions.u: Supreme Court, High Court & Subordinate Courts

questions.q:
With reference to India, consider the following statements:
1. Government law officers and legal firms are recognised as advocates, but corporate lawyers and patent attorneys are excluded from recognition as advocates.
2. Bar Councils have the power to lay down the rules relating to legal education and recognition of law colleges.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Under the Advocates Act, only enrolled individuals are advocates; law firms are not, and corporate lawyers are not excluded as a class. The Bar Council of India regulates legal education and recognises law colleges.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q12
questions.u: Justice Administration, Law Enforcement & Statutory Frameworks

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. A bill amending the Constitution requires a prior recommendation of the President of India.
2. When a Constitution Amendment Bill is presented to the President of India, it is obligatory for the President of India to give his/her assent.
3. A Constitution Amendment Bill must be passed by both the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha by a special majority and there is no provision for joint sitting.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: An amendment bill needs no prior Presidential recommendation, must pass each House by special majority without joint sitting, and the President must give assent (24th Amendment).
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q13

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Constitution of India classifies the ministers into four ranks viz. Cabinet Minister, Minister of State with Independent Charge, Minister of State and Deputy Minister.
2. The total number of ministers in the Union Government, including the Prime Minister, shall not exceed 15 percent of the total number of members in the Lok Sabha.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The ranks of ministers are a matter of convention, not the Constitution. Article 75(1A) caps the Council of Ministers at 15% of the Lok Sabha's strength.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q14

questions.q:
Which of the following is/are the exclusive power(s) of Lok Sabha?
1. To ratify the declaration of Emergency
2. To pass a motion of no-confidence against the Council of Ministers
3. To impeach the President of India
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Only the Lok Sabha can pass a no-confidence motion. Emergency approval needs both Houses, and impeachment can start in either House.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q15

questions.q:
With reference to anti-defection law in India, consider the following statements:
1. The law specifies that a nominated legislator cannot join any political party within six months of being appointed to the House.
2. The law does not provide any time-frame within which the presiding officer has to decide a defection case.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: A nominated member may join a party within six months of taking a seat, not the reverse. The Tenth Schedule sets no time limit for the presiding officer's decision.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q16

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Attorney General of India and Solicitor General of India are the only officers of the Government who are allowed to participate in the meetings of the Parliament of India.
2. According to the Constitution of India, the Attorney General of India submits his resignation when the Government which appointed him resigns.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Article 88 gives the Attorney General (not the Solicitor General) the right to take part in Parliament. The Constitution does not require the AG to resign with the government.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q17

questions.q:
With reference to the writs issued by the Courts in India, consider the following statements:
1. Mandamus will not lie against a private organisation unless it is entrusted with a public duty.
2. Mandamus will not lie against a Company even though it may be a Government Company.
3. Any public minded person can be a petitioner to move the Court to obtain the writ of Quo Warranto.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Mandamus lies against a private body only if it performs a public duty, and per UPSC's key not against a company even if government-owned. Any person can seek quo warranto. All three are correct per the key.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q18
questions.u: Supreme Court, High Court & Subordinate Courts

questions.q:
With reference to Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, consider the following statements:
1. Private and public hospitals must adopt it.
2. As it aims to achieve universal health coverage, every citizen of India should be part of it ultimately.
3. It has seamless portability across the country.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission is voluntary for hospitals and citizens, but health records are portable across India. Only 3 is correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q19

questions.q:
With reference to Deputy Speaker of Lok Sabha, consider the following statements:
1. As per the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha, the election of Deputy Speaker shall be held on such date as the Speaker may fix.
2. There is a mandatory provision that the election of a candidate as Deputy Speaker of Lok Sabha shall be from either the principal opposition party or the ruling party.
3. The Deputy Speaker has the same power as of the Speaker when presiding over the sitting of the House and no appeal lies against his rulings.
4. The well established parliamentary practice regarding the appointment of Deputy Speaker is that the motion is moved by the Speaker and duly seconded by the Prime Minister.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Speaker fixes the date of the Deputy Speaker's election, and when presiding the Deputy Speaker has the Speaker's full powers. No rule reserves the post for a party, and the motion is moved by members, not the Speaker.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q20

questions.q: Among the following crops, which one is the most important anthropogenic source of both methane and nitrous oxide?
questions.e: Flooded paddy releases methane, and heavy nitrogen fertiliser adds nitrous oxide; rice is the main crop source of both.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q21

questions.q:
"System of Rice Intensification" of cultivation, in which alternate wetting and drying of rice fields is practised, results in:
1. Reduced seed requirement
2. Reduced methane production
3. Reduced electricity consumption
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: SRI uses fewer, widely spaced seedlings, keeps fields moist rather than flooded (less methane), and needs less pumping. All three are results.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q22

questions.q: Which one of the following lakes of West Africa has become dry and turned into a desert?
questions.e: Lake Faguibine near Timbuktu in Mali dried up after droughts and turned largely into desert.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q23

questions.q: Gandikota canyon of South India was created by which one of the following rivers?
questions.e: The Gandikota gorge in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, was cut by the Pennar river.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q24

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: Peak Mountains
1. Namcha Barwa Garhwal Himalaya
2. Nanda Devi Kumaon Himalaya
3. Nokrek Sikkim Himalaya
Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
questions.e: Nanda Devi is in the Kumaon Himalaya. Namcha Barwa is in the eastern Himalaya (Tibet) and Nokrek is in Meghalaya's Garo hills.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q25

questions.q: The term "Levant" often heard in the news roughly corresponds to which of the following regions?
o: Region along the eastern Mediterranean shores
Region along North African shores stretching from Egypt to Morocco
Region along Persian Gulf and Horn of Africa
The entire coastal areas of Mediterranean Sea
questions.e: The Levant is the eastern Mediterranean coast: Syria, Lebanon, Israel, Palestine and Jordan.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q26

questions.q:
Consider the following countries:
1. Azerbaijan
2. Kyrgyzstan
3. Tajikistan
4. Turkmenistan
5. Uzbekistan
Which of the above have borders with Afghanistan?
questions.e: Afghanistan borders Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan (plus Iran, Pakistan and China). Kyrgyzstan and Azerbaijan do not touch it.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q27

questions.q:
With reference to India, consider the following statements:
1. Monazite is a source of rare earths.
2. Monazite contains thorium.
3. Monazite occurs naturally in the entire Indian coastal sands in India.
4. In India, Government bodies only can process or export monazite.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Monazite contains rare earths and thorium and can be handled only by authorised government bodies. It occurs in certain coastal sands, not all.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q28

questions.q: In the northern hemisphere, the longest day of the year normally occurs in the:
o: First half of the month of June
Second half of the month of June
First half of the month of July
Second half of the month of July
questions.e: The northern summer solstice falls around 21 June, in the second half of June.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q29

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: Wetland/Lake Location
1. Hokera Wetland Punjab
2. Renuka Wetland Himachal Pradesh
3. Rudrasagar Lake Tripura
4. Sasthamkotta Lake Tamil Nadu
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Renuka (Himachal Pradesh) and Rudrasagar (Tripura) are correct. Hokera is in Jammu and Kashmir and Sasthamkotta in Kerala.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q30

questions.q:
Consider the following:
1. Aarogya Setu
2. CoWIN
3. DigiLocker
4. DIKSHA
Which of the above are built on top of open-source digital platforms?
questions.e: Aarogya Setu, CoWIN, DigiLocker and DIKSHA are all built on open-source digital public infrastructure.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q31

questions.q:
With reference to Web 3.0, consider the following statements:
1. Web 3.0 technology enables people to control their own data.
2. In Web 3.0 world, there can be blockchain based social networks.
3. Web 3.0 is operated by users collectively rather than a corporation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Web 3.0 is a decentralised blockchain internet where users control their data, social networks can run on blockchains, and users collectively govern platforms.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q32

questions.q:
With reference to "Software as a Service (SaaS)", consider the following statements:
1. SaaS buyers can customise the user interface and can change data fields.
2. SaaS users can access their data through their mobile devices.
3. Outlook, Hotmail and Yahoo! Mail are forms of SaaS.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: SaaS apps run on the provider's cloud and are reached from any device; users can customise their interface and fields. Web email like Outlook and Yahoo Mail is SaaS.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q33

questions.q: Which one of the following statements best reflects the idea behind the "Fractional Orbital Bombardment System" often talked about in media?
o: A hypersonic missile is launched into space to counter the asteroid approaching the Earth and explode it in space.
A spacecraft lands on another planet after making several orbital motions.
A missile is put into a stable orbit around the Earth and deorbits over a target on the Earth.
A spacecraft moves along a comet with the same speed and places a probe on its surface.
questions.e: FOBS puts a warhead in a partial orbit and brings it down on a target before it completes a full circuit.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q34

questions.q: Which one of the following is the context in which the term "qubit" is mentioned?
questions.e: A qubit is the basic unit of information in quantum computing; it can hold a superposition of 0 and 1.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q35

questions.q:
Consider the following communication technologies:
1. Closed-circuit Television
2. Radio Frequency Identification
3. Wireless Local Area Network
Which of the above are considered Short-Range devices/technologies?
questions.e: CCTV, RFID and wireless LANs are classed as short-range devices.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q36

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Biofilms can form on medical implants within human tissues.
2. Biofilms can form on food and food processing surfaces.
3. Biofilms can exhibit antibiotic resistance.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Biofilms form on implants and food surfaces, and microbes in them resist antibiotics better. All three are correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q37

questions.q:
Consider the following statements in respect of probiotics:
1. Probiotics are made of both bacteria and yeast.
2. The organisms in probiotics are found in foods we ingest but they do not naturally occur in our gut.
3. Probiotics help in the digestion of milk sugars.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Probiotics include bacteria and yeasts, and some help digest lactose. Many probiotic microbes already live in our gut, so 2 is wrong.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q38

questions.q:
In the context of vaccines manufactured to prevent COVID-19 pandemic, consider the following statements:
1. The Serum Institute of India produced COVID-19 vaccine named Covishield using mRNA platform.
2. Sputnik V vaccine is manufactured using vector based platform.
3. COVAXIN is an inactivated pathogen based vaccine.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Sputnik V is a viral-vector vaccine and COVAXIN an inactivated-virus vaccine. Covishield is also viral-vector, not mRNA.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q39

questions.q:
If a major solar storm (solar flare) reaches the Earth, which of the following are the possible effects on the Earth?
1. GPS and navigation systems could fail.
2. Tsunamis could occur at equatorial regions.
3. Power grids could be damaged.
4. Intense auroras could occur over much of the Earth.
5. Forest fires could take place over much of the planet.
6. Orbits of the satellites could be disturbed.
7. Shortwave radio communication of the aircraft flying over polar regions could be interrupted.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Solar storms can disrupt GPS, damage grids, cause widespread auroras, disturb satellite orbits and black out polar HF radio. They do not cause tsunamis or forest fires.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q40

questions.q: "Climate Action Tracker" which monitors the emission reduction pledges of different countries is a:
o: Database created by coalition of research organisations
Wing of "International Panel of Climate Change"
Committee under "United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change"
Agency promoted and financed by United Nations Environment Programme and World Bank
questions.e: The Climate Action Tracker is an independent analysis by Climate Analytics and NewClimate Institute.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q41

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. "The Climate Group" is an international non-profit organization that drives climate action by building large networks and runs them.
2. The International Energy Agency in partnership with the Climate Group launched a global initiative "EP100".
3. EP100 brings together leading companies committed to driving innovation in energy efficiency and increasing competitiveness while delivering on emission reduction goals.
4. Some Indian companies are members of EP100.
5. The International Energy Agency is the Secretariat to the "Under2 Coalition".
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Climate Group builds climate networks; EP100 brings companies, including Indian ones, together on energy efficiency. EP100 was launched by the Climate Group with the Alliance to Save Energy, and the Climate Group (not IEA) runs the Under2 Coalition.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q42

questions.q: "If rainforests and tropical forests are the lungs of the Earth, then surely wetlands function as its kidneys." Which one of the following functions of wetlands best reflects the above statement?
o: The water cycle in wetlands involves surface runoff, subsoil percolation and evaporation.
Algae form the nutrient base upon which fish, crustaceans, molluscs, birds, reptiles and mammals thrive.
Wetlands play a vital role in maintaining sedimentation balance and soil stabilization.
Aquatic plants absorb heavy metals and excess nutrients.
questions.e: Like kidneys filtering blood, wetland plants filter heavy metals and excess nutrients from water.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q43

questions.q:
In the context of WHO Air Quality Guidelines, consider the following statements:
1. The 24-hour mean of PM2.5 should not exceed 15 µg/m3 and annual mean of PM2.5 should not exceed 5 µg/m3.
2. In a year, the highest levels of ozone pollution occur during the periods of inclement weather.
3. PM10 can penetrate the lung barrier and enter the bloodstream.
4. Excessive ozone in the air can trigger asthma.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: WHO's 2021 guidelines set PM2.5 at 15 µg/m³ (24-hour) and 5 (annual), and ozone can trigger asthma. Ozone peaks in sunny weather, and it is PM2.5 that can enter the blood.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q44

questions.q:
With reference to "Gucchi" sometimes mentioned in the news, consider the following statements:
1. It is a fungus.
2. It grows in some Himalayan forest areas.
3. It is commercially cultivated in the Himalayan foothills of north-eastern India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Gucchi is the morel mushroom, a fungus that grows wild in Himalayan forests. It is collected from the wild, not commercially cultivated in the north-east.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q45

questions.q:
With reference to polyethylene terephthalate, the use of which is so widespread in our daily lives, consider the following statements:
1. Its fibres can be blended with wool and cotton fibres to reinforce their properties.
2. Containers made of it can be used to store any alcoholic beverage.
3. Bottles made of it can be recycled into other products.
4. Articles made of it can be easily disposed of by incineration without causing greenhouse gas emissions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: PET fibres are blended with wool and cotton, and PET bottles are recycled. PET is not suited to storing all alcohol, and burning it releases greenhouse gases.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q46

questions.q: Which of the following is not a bird?
questions.e: The golden mahseer is a fish. Nightjar, spoonbill and ibis are birds.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q47

questions.q:
Which of the following are nitrogen-fixing plants?
1. Alfalfa
2. Amaranth
3. Chickpea
4. Clover
5. Purslane (Kulfa)
6. Spinach
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Alfalfa, chickpea and clover are legumes with nitrogen-fixing root nodules. Amaranth, purslane and spinach are not.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q48

questions.q: "Biorock technology" is talked about in which one of the following situations?
o: Development of building materials using plant residues
Identification of areas for exploration/extraction of shale gas
Providing salt licks for wild animals in forests/protected areas
questions.e: Biorock passes a low electric current through submerged frames so limestone forms and corals grow fast; it restores damaged reefs.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q49

questions.q: The "Miyawaki method" is well known for the:
o: Promotion of commercial farming in arid and semi- arid areas
Development of gardens using genetically modified flora
Creation of mini forests in urban areas
Harvesting wind energy on coastal areas and on sea surfaces
questions.e: The Miyawaki method plants many native species densely to create mini forests in urban areas.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q50

questions.q:
In the Government of India Act 1919, the functions of Provincial Government were divided into "Reserved" and "Transferred" subjects. Which of the following were treated as "Reserved" subjects?
1. Administration of Justice
2. Local Self-Government
3. Land Revenue
4. Police
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Under 1919 dyarchy, justice, land revenue and police were reserved subjects. Local self-government was transferred.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q51

questions.q: In medieval India, the term "Fanam" referred to:
questions.e: Fanam was a small coin used in medieval South India.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q52

questions.q:
Consider the following freedom fighters:
1. Barindra Kumar Ghosh
2. Jogesh Chandra Chatterjee
3. Rash Behari Bose
Who of the above was/were actively associated with the Ghadar Party?
questions.e: Rash Behari Bose worked with the Ghadarites on the 1915 uprising plan. Barindra Ghosh and Jogesh Chatterjee belonged to Bengal revolutionary groups.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q53

questions.q:
With reference to the proposals of Cripps Mission, consider the following statements:
1. The Constituent Assembly would have members nominated by the Provincial Assemblies as well as the Princely States.
2. Any Province, which is not prepared to accept the new Constitution would have the right to sign a separate agreement with Britain regarding its future status.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Cripps allowed provinces not accepting the constitution to make separate arrangements with Britain. Provincial members of the Constituent Assembly were to be elected, not nominated.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q54

questions.q:
With reference to Indian history, consider the following texts:
1. Nettipakarana
2. Parishishtaparvan
3. Avadanashataka
4. Trishashtilakshana Mahapurana
Which of the above are Jaina texts?
questions.e: Parishishtaparvan (Hemachandra) and Trishashtilakshana Mahapurana are Jaina texts. Nettipakarana and Avadanashataka are Buddhist.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q55

questions.q:
With reference to Indian history, consider the following pairs: Historical person Known as
1. Aryadeva Jaina scholar
2. Dignaga Buddhist scholar
3. Nathamuni Vaishnava scholar
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Dignaga was a Buddhist logician and Nathamuni a Vaishnava teacher. Aryadeva was a Buddhist, not a Jaina.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q56

questions.q:
With reference to Indian history, consider the following statements:
1. The first Mongol invasion of India happened during the reign of Jalal-ud-din Khalji.
2. During the reign of Ala-ud-din Khalji, one Mongol assault marched up to Delhi and besieged the city.
3. Muhammad-bin-Tughlaq temporarily lost portions of north-west of his kingdom to Mongols.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: A Mongol army besieged Delhi in 1303 under Alauddin Khalji. Mongol raids began under Iltutmish, and Muhammad bin Tughluq did not lose north-western territory to them per the key.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q57

questions.q: With reference to Indian history, who of the following were known as "Kulah-Daran"?
questions.e: The Kulah-Daran ('cap-wearers') were the Sayyids, descendants of the Prophet.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q58

questions.q:
With reference to Indian history, consider the following statements:
1. The Dutch established their factories/warehouses on the east coast on lands granted to them by Gajapati rulers.
2. Alfonso de Albuquerque captured Goa from the Bijapur Sultanate.
3. The English East India Company established a factory at Madras on a plot of land leased from a representative of the Vijayanagara empire.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Albuquerque took Goa from Bijapur in 1510, and the English got the Madras site in 1639 from a Vijayanagara representative. The Dutch did not get east coast lands from the Gajapatis.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q59

questions.q:
According to Kautilya's Arthashastra, which of the following are correct?
1. A person could be a slave as a result of a judicial punishment.
2. If a female slave bore her master a son, she was legally free.
3. If a son born to a female slave was fathered by her master, the son was entitled to the legal status of the master's son.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Arthashastra says a female slave who bore her master a son became free, and the son had the status of the master's son. Per UPSC's key, slavery by judicial punishment is not the correct reading.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q60

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Tight monetary policy of US Federal Reserve could lead to capital flight.
2. Capital flight may increase the interest cost of firms with existing External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs).
3. Devaluation of domestic currency decreases the currency risk associated with ECBs.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: UPSC dropped this question. Tight US policy can cause capital flight, and a weaker rupee raises, not lowers, the currency risk of foreign borrowing.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q61

questions.q:
Consider the following States:
1. Andhra Pradesh
2. Kerala
3. Himachal Pradesh
4. Tripura
How many of the above are generally known as tea-producing States?
questions.e: Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh and Tripura all produce tea.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q62

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. In India, credit rating agencies are regulated by Reserve Bank of India.
2. The rating agency popularly known as ICRA is a public limited company.
3. Brickwork Ratings is an Indian credit rating agency.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Credit rating agencies are regulated by SEBI, not the RBI. ICRA is a public limited company and Brickwork is an Indian agency.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q63

questions.q:
With reference to the 'Banks Board Bureau (BBB)', which of the following statements are correct?
1. The Governor of RBI is the Chairman of BBB.
2. BBB recommends for the selection of heads for Public Sector Banks.
3. BBB helps the Public Sector Banks in developing strategies and capital raising plans.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The Banks Board Bureau recommended heads of public sector banks and helped with strategy and capital plans. It was not chaired by the RBI Governor.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q64

questions.q:
With reference to Convertible Bonds, consider the following statements:
1. As there is an option to exchange the bond for equity, Convertible Bonds pay a lower rate of interest.
2. The option to convert to equity affords the bondholder a degree of indexation to rising consumer prices.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Convertible bonds pay lower interest because of the conversion option, and the equity option offers some protection against rising prices. Both are correct per UPSC's key.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q65

questions.q:
Consider the following:
1. Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank
2. Missile Technology Control Regime
3. Shanghai Cooperation Organisation India is a member of which of the above?
questions.e: India is a founding member of AIIB, joined the MTCR in 2016 and became a full SCO member in 2017.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q66

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Vietnam has been one of the fastest growing economies in the world in the recent years.
2. Vietnam is led by a multi-party political system.
3. Vietnam's economic growth is linked to its integration with global supply chains and focus on exports.
4. For a long time Vietnam's low labour costs and stable exchange rates have attracted global manufacturers.
5. Vietnam has the most productive e-service sector in the Indo-Pacific region.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: Vietnam's fast, export-led growth draws on supply chain integration and low labour costs. It is a one-party state and is not known for the most productive e-services.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q67

questions.q: In India, which one of the following is responsible for maintaining price stability by controlling inflation?
questions.e: The RBI, through its Monetary Policy Committee, is responsible for price stability and the inflation target.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q68

questions.q:
With reference to Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs), consider the following statements:
1. They enable the digital representation of physical assets.
2. They are unique cryptographic tokens that exist on a blockchain.
3. They can be traded or exchanged at equivalency and therefore can be used as medium of commercial transactions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: NFTs are unique blockchain tokens that can represent digital or physical assets. Being non-fungible, they cannot be exchanged at equivalency as money.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q69

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: Reservoirs States
1. Ghataprabha Telangana
2. Gandhi Sagar Madhya Pradesh
3. Indira Sagar Andhra Pradesh
4. Maithon Chhattisgarh
How many pairs given above are not correctly matched?
questions.e: Only Gandhi Sagar (Madhya Pradesh) is right. Ghataprabha is in Karnataka, Indira Sagar in Madhya Pradesh and Maithon in Jharkhand.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q70

questions.q: In India, which one of the following compiles information on industrial disputes, closures, retrenchments and lay- offs in factories employing workers?
o: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
questions.e: The Labour Bureau compiles statistics on industrial disputes, closures, retrenchments and lay-offs.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q71

questions.q:
In India, what is the role of the Coal Controller’s Organization (CCO)?
1. CCO is the major source of Coal Statistics in Government of India.
2. It monitors progress of development of Captive Coal/Lignite blocks.
3. It hears any objection to the Government’s notification relating to acquisition of coal-bearing areas.
4. It ensures that coal mining companies deliver the coal to end users in the prescribed time.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: The Coal Controller's Organisation compiles coal statistics, monitors captive blocks and hears objections on acquisition of coal areas. It does not enforce delivery timelines.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q72

questions.q: If a particular area is brought under the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution of India, which one of the following statements best reflects the consequence of it?
o: This would prevent the transfer of land of tribal people to non-tribal people.
This would create a local self-governing body in that area.
This would convert that area into a Union Territory.
The State having such areas would be declared a Special Category State.
questions.e: In Fifth Schedule areas the Governor can regulate and prohibit transfer of tribal land to non-tribals.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q73

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. The India Sanitation Coalition is a platform to promote sustainable sanitation and is funded by the Government of India and the World Health Organization.
2. The National Institute of Urban Affairs is an apex body of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs in Government of India and provides innovative solutions to address the challenges of Urban India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The India Sanitation Coalition is an industry-led platform (FICCI), not funded by the Government and WHO. NIUA is an autonomous institute, not the Ministry's apex body. Neither is correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q74

questions.q: Which one of the following has been constituted under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986?
questions.e: The Central Ground Water Authority was constituted under Section 3(3) of the Environment (Protection) Act 1986.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q75

questions.q:
With reference to the “United Nations Credentials Committee”, consider the following statements:
1. It is a committee set up by the UN Security Council and works under its supervision.
2. It traditionally meets in March, June and September every year.
3. It assesses the credentials of all UN members before submitting a report to the General Assembly for approval.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: The Credentials Committee is a General Assembly body that checks member states' representatives' credentials and reports to the Assembly. It is not under the Security Council.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q76

questions.q: Which one of the following statements best describes the ‘Polar Code’?
o: It is the international code of safety for ships operating in polar waters.
It is the agreement of the countries around the North Pole regarding the demarcation of their territories in the polar region.
It is a set of norms to be followed by the countries whose scientists undertake research studies in the North Pole and South Pole.
It is a trade and security agreement of the member countries of the Arctic Council.
questions.e: The Polar Code is the IMO's safety and environmental code for ships in Arctic and Antarctic waters.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q77

questions.q:
With reference to the United Nations General Assembly, consider the following statements:
1. The UN General Assembly can grant observer status to the non-member States.
2. Inter-governmental organisations can seek observer status in the UN General Assembly.
3. Permanent Observers in the UN General Assembly can maintain missions at the UN headquarters.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The General Assembly grants observer status to non-member states and intergovernmental bodies, and permanent observers keep missions at UN headquarters.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q78

questions.q:
With reference to the “Tea Board” in India, consider the following statements:
1. The Tea Board is a statutory body.
2. It is a regulatory body attached to the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
3. The Tea Board’s Head Office is situated in Bengaluru.
4. The Board has overseas offices at Dubai and Moscow.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: The Tea Board is a statutory body with offices in Dubai and Moscow. It is under the Commerce Ministry and headquartered in Kolkata.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q79

questions.q: Which one of the following best describes the term “greenwashing”?
o: Conveying a false impression that a company’s products are eco-friendly and environmentally sound
Non-inclusion of ecological/environmental costs in the Annual Financial Statements of a country
Ignoring the disastrous ecological consequences while undertaking infrastructure development
Making mandatory provisions for environmental costs in a government project/programme
questions.e: Greenwashing is giving a false impression that a company's products are environmentally friendly.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q80

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. High clouds primarily reflect solar radiation and cool the surface of the Earth.
2. Low clouds have a high absorption of infrared radiation emanating from the Earth’s surface and thus cause warming effect.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Low thick clouds mainly reflect sunlight and cool the surface, while high thin clouds trap outgoing heat and warm it. Both statements reverse this.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q81

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bidibidi is a large refugee settlement in north-western Kenya.
2. Some people who fled from South Sudan civil war live in Bidibidi.
3. Some people who fled from civil war in Somalia live in Dadaab refugee complex in Kenya.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Bidibidi is in Uganda, not Kenya, and hosts South Sudanese refugees. Kenya's Dadaab complex houses Somalis.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q82

questions.q:
Consider the following countries:
1. Armenia
2. Azerbaijan
3. Croatia
4. Romania
5. Uzbekistan
Which of the above are members of the Organization of Turkic States?
questions.e: Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan are members of the Organization of Turkic States; Armenia, Croatia and Romania are not.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q83

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Gujarat has the largest solar park in India.
2. Kerala has a fully solar powered International Airport.
3. Goa has the largest floating solar photovoltaic project in India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Cochin airport in Kerala is fully solar-powered. The largest solar park was Bhadla in Rajasthan, and Goa did not have the largest floating solar project.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q84

questions.q:
With reference to the United Nations Convention on the Law of Sea, consider the following statements:
1. A coastal state has the right to establish the breadth of its territorial sea up to a limit not exceeding 12 nautical miles, measured from baseline determined in accordance with the convention.
2. Ships of all states, whether coastal or land-locked, enjoy the right of innocent passage through the territorial sea.
3. The Exclusive Economic Zone shall not extend beyond 200 nautical miles from the baseline from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.e: UNCLOS sets the territorial sea at up to 12 nm, gives all ships innocent passage, and caps the EEZ at 200 nm. All three are correct.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q85

questions.q: Which one of the following statements best reflects the issue with Senkaku Islands, sometimes mentioned in the news?
o: It is generally believed that they are artificial islands made by a country around South China Sea.
China and Japan engage in maritime disputes over these islands in East China Sea.
A permanent American military base has been set up there to help Taiwan to increase its defence capabilities.
Though International Court of Justice declared them as no man’s land, some South-East Asian countries claim them.
questions.e: The Senkaku Islands in the East China Sea are administered by Japan and claimed by China.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q86

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: Country Important reason for being in the news recently
1. Chad Setting up of permanent military base by China
2. Guinea Suspension of Constitution and Government by military
3. Lebanon Severe and prolonged economic depression
4. Tunisia Suspension of Parliament by President
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Guinea had a military coup, Lebanon a deep economic crisis and Tunisia's President suspended Parliament. China's overseas base is in Djibouti, not Chad.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q87

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: Region often mentioned in the news Country
1. Anatolia Turkey
2. Amhara Ethiopia
3. Cabo Delgado Spain
4. Catalonia Italy
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Anatolia is in Turkey and Amhara in Ethiopia. Cabo Delgado is in Mozambique and Catalonia in Spain.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q88

questions.q:
With reference to Indian laws about wildlife protection, consider the following statements:
1. Wild animals are the sole property of the government.
2. When a wild animal is declared protected, such animal is entitled for equal protection whether it is found in protected areas or outside.
3. Apprehension of a protected wild animal becoming a danger to human life is sufficient ground for its capture or killing.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Protected animals get equal protection inside and outside protected areas. Not all wild animals are government property, and mere apprehension of danger is not enough to kill one.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q89

questions.q: Certain species of which one of the following organisms are well known as cultivators of fungi?
questions.e: Leafcutter and other attine ants grow fungus gardens as food.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q90

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: Site of Ashoka's major rock edicts Location in the State of
1. Dhauli Odisha
2. Erragudi Andhra Pradesh
3. Jaugada Madhya Pradesh
4. Kalsi Karnataka
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Dhauli is in Odisha and Erragudi in Andhra Pradesh. Jaugada is in Odisha and Kalsi in Uttarakhand.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q91

questions.q:
Consider the following pairs: King Dynasty
1. Nannuka Chandela
2. Jayashakti Paramara
3. Nagabhata II Gurjara-Pratihara
4. Bhoja Rashtrakuta
How many pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.e: Nannuka founded the Chandela line and Nagabhata II was a Gurjara-Pratihara. Jayashakti was a Chandela, and Bhoja (Mihira Bhoja) was a Pratihara.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q92

questions.q: Which one of the following statements about Sangam literature in ancient South India is correct?
o: Sangam poems are devoid of any reference to material culture.
The social classification of Varna was known to Sangam poets.
Sangam poems have no reference to warrior ethic.
Sangam literature refers to magical forces as irrational.
questions.e: Sangam poets knew the varna classification. The poems are full of material culture and warrior values.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q93

questions.q: "Yogavāsistha" was translated into Persian by Nizamuddin Panipati during the reign of:
questions.e: Nizamuddin Panipati translated the Yogavasistha into Persian in Akbar's reign.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q94

questions.q: The world's second tallest statue in sitting pose of Ramanuja was inaugurated by the Prime Minister of India at Hyderabad recently. Which one of the following statements correctly represents the teachings of Ramanuja?
o: The best means of salvation was devotion.
Vedas are eternal, self-existent and wholly authoritative.
Logical arguments were essential means for the highest bliss.
Salvation was to be obtained through meditation.
questions.e: Ramanuja taught that devotion (bhakti) to Vishnu is the best path to salvation.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q95

questions.q:
The Prime Minister recently inaugurated the new Circuit House near Somnath Temple at Veraval. Which of the following statements are correct regarding Somnath Temple?
1. Somnath Temple is one of the Jyotirlinga shrines.
2. A description of Somnath Temple was given by Al-Biruni.
3. Pran Pratishtha of Somnath Temple (installation of the present day temple) was done by President S. Radhakrishnan.
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.e: Somnath is one of the twelve Jyotirlingas and Al-Biruni described it. The present temple's Pran Pratishtha was done by President Rajendra Prasad in 1951, not Radhakrishnan.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q96

questions.q: Which one of the following statements best describes the role of B cells and T cells in the human body?
o: They protect the body from environmental allergens.
They alleviate the body's pain and inflammation.
They act as immunosuppressants in the body.
They protect the body from the diseases caused by pathogens.
questions.e: B and T lymphocytes drive the specific immune response that protects against disease-causing pathogens.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q97

questions.q:
Consider the following statements:
1. Other than those made by humans, nanoparticles do not exist in nature.
2. Nanoparticles of some metallic oxides are used in the manufacture of some cosmetics.
3. Nanoparticles of some commercial products which enter the environment are unsafe for humans.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: Metal oxide nanoparticles are used in cosmetics, and some released nanoparticles can be unsafe. Nanoparticles also occur naturally, so 1 is wrong.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q98

questions.q:
Consider the following statements: DNA Barcoding can be a tool to:
1. assess the age of a plant or animal.
2. distinguish among species that look alike.
3. identify undesirable animal or plant materials in processed foods.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.e: DNA barcoding identifies species from a short gene sequence, so it separates look-alike species and detects unwanted species in food. It cannot tell an organism's age.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q99

questions.q:
Consider the following:
1. Carbon monoxide
2. Nitrogen oxide
3. Ozone
4. Sulphur dioxide Excess of which of the above in the environment is/are cause(s) of acid rain?
questions.e: Nitrogen oxides and sulphur dioxide form nitric and sulphuric acids that fall as acid rain.
questions.s: UPSC Prelims 2022, GS Paper I, Q100
